findings.detail: child_key_components entries in THIS bundle carry NO 'kind' field. The sub-keys are name / value / resolved_on_view, plus a bare 'note' on 48 of 296. A generator written against a kind-bearing map matches nothing, returns None, and the build reports a false SOURCE gap (s2). Stage 1 MUST read name/value/resolved_on_view from map_fields.child_key_components and raise on anything else.

The bundle spells prose fields BARE 'note' on target, augmentation, reanchor AND inside child_key_components - not '_note'. A '.endswith("_note")' guard returns False and parses them. Stage 1 must use the declared allow-list in bundle_prose_fields, never a suffix test (s3.7).

No climb or cross grammar exists in this LOB: spine[ = 0 and >> = 0 over 5,089 expression-bearing strings. Stage 1 must NOT emit walk-only casts or ancestor resolvers - there is nothing for them to range over. All 833 key expressions are literal SQL business keys, link composites or content hashes.

Canonical key md5(upper('HUB_X|' || <bk>)) emitted EXPLICITLY; no macro computes a hash. Feasibility is proven by an existing artifact - v2 already emits 364 explicit md5( calls across 181 models with zero package macros. dbt_packages/ and package-lock.yml are absent in BOTH projects, so automate_dv's hash cannot be read or verified. Correction to the brief: v2 has NO packages.yml at all, not an empty one.

FIVE s9.8 reconciliation caveats exist in the two originals, not one: hub_party, hub_claim, hub_policy, hub_product and lnk_party_role. ALL FIVE must be reproduced VERBATIM in the consolidated headers from carried_forward_caveats.json. lnk_party_role's is the most consequential - the one-leg link hash key is byte-equal to HUB_PARTY_HK and the role token is absent from the key entirely. Losing one in the merge is the single real regression available in this assignment.

The namespace decision separates HUBS, not registries WITHIN a hub. 6 of 14 shared hubs have ZERO BK-column overlap between the runs and hub_party intersects on only 2 of 35 columns, so unifying the hash form does NOT make the two halves joinable. Nobody may read the key decision as resolving reconciliation. Measured justification for the namespace nonetheless: v2 keys HUB_ASSESSMENT and HUB_PROPOSAL from the SAME SCRUTINY_NO column, which would collide without it.

The two siblings DISAGREE on hashdiff naming - legacy bare HASHDIFF on all 139 satellites, v2 <SAT_NAME>_HASHDIFF on all 87. s7.1/s7.2 cannot decide it because there are two equally-entitled siblings, and the model does not govern a convention. Recommending SAT_<NAME>_HASHDIFF, RECOMMENDED_NOT_RATIFIED. Needs a ruling before stage 1 emits a satellite.

REFUSE AND DECLARE, do not normalise: ZERO of 422 legacy blocks on the 16 shared multi-active satellites name a child-key leg - not one - so there is no spelling to normalise from. Stage 1 must emit those feeds with NO fabricated discriminator and declare the unresolved grain in the satellite header AND the unresolved-grain register. The sole relabel exception is SAT_POLICY_DISCOUNT_LOADING_APPLIED's 30 blocks, concept-for-concept, only where v2 has a counterpart code.

SAT_RISK_HEALTH_MEMBER_MEDICAL carries THREE stacked defects and fixing only the first leaves the key space split: (1) the Member Reference leg is absent on all 11 blocks; (2) the Condition Code leg is spelled two ways by two SOURCE TABLES within one run - BA_HCP_PROD_8439_CLH_LOADER/MD_DIABETES yields 'Diabetes', BJAZ_HCF_MEMBER_DTLS/DIABETES_LOAD yields 'DIABETES', colliding case-insensitively on diabetes, hypertension and obesity; (3) 'Cholesterol Disorders' vs 'HYPERLIPIDEMIA' is a SYNONYM CANDIDATE, not an assertion. The vocabularies overlap on 3 and diverge on 3, so a case-folding normaliser would merge three and silently leave the rest split. All three go in the header verbatim.

The PARTY_HK / PARTY_HKEY split the caller flagged is a HUB-FEED vs SATELLITE-FEED role split, NOT standard vs augmented and NOT a defect: PARTY_HK has 59 standard producers (stg2_sat_*) and 10 augmented; PARTY_HKEY's 199 are all hub/link-feeding stages; no model produces both; both render 'HUB_PARTY|' || <col> so they agree in VALUE; and all 267 hub source_model entries produce their declared src_pk with 0 gaps. And 'Gate Findings'.Source Column is 2290 of 2319 bare identifiers - mostly parseable is still prose, and the 29 exceptions are precisely what would reach generated SQL.

CORRECTION TO A STANDING INSTRUCTION, and the most important finding of the re-entry. It is NOT true that 'the child-key field is key_name' or that 'there is no child_key_value field'. MEASURED on the settled map: target.child_key_value present on 1002 rows / truthy on 276, augmentation.child_key_value truthy on 248, holding exactly the values the R6 analysis rests on ('Per-Member Certificate', 'Base Cover', 'Family Discount'). target.key_name holds 37 distinct HUB business-key NAMES ('Policy Number (canonical contract key)') on 306 rows and is DISJOINT from child_key_value - zero rows populate both. Stage 1 must read child_key_value and child_key_components; key_name must go nowhere near a child key. Writing key_name into a child key would push prose carrying parentheses into generated SQL - the exact s3 defect that produced MODEL_SINGLE_ACTIVE_BUILD_SIDE_MULTI_ACTIVE_ASK. The coordinator's own pinned R6_childkey_value_kind.json is built FROM child_key_value, so the claim contradicts the artefact shipped beside it.

PROVISIONAL_PENDING_STAGE65 is CLEARED. The legacy half is now derived from 04_column_map.SETTLED_post_stage65.json. What MOVED: 140 anchors, 44 satellite homes, 30 outcomes (29 needs_reanchor->augmentation_needed, 1 mapped->augmentation_needed), all legacy. What did NOT move: 0 resolved_key expressions, the 16 shared multi-active satellites, 422/0 and 171/168, and the whole 62-loader structure. The covering note's 126 / 15 / 29 are corrected to 140 / 44 / 30 by measurement.

SAT_RISK_PERSON_MEMBER joins refuse-and-declare as a 17th satellite, with two corrections. (1) It is LEGACY-ONLY, not a 16th SHARED multi-active satellite: all 59 rows are legacy, 0 are v2, and sat_risk_person_member is in the 140 legacy-only vault tables - so the shared count stays 16 and this needs a single-feed loader. (2) BUILD FROM THE GROUP (54), NOT THE RE-ANCHOR LIST (45): the 9 'Pre-Existing Disease Description' rows share the group and the null child key but were never re-anchored, and would be silently undeclared. Model child key is 'Member Sequence', null on all 59. DO NOT synthesise it from MEMBER1..8 - the SELF slot has no number, so any derivation must invent one. check_collapse SKIPS this satellite, so its silence is NOT_MEASURABLE, not a clean bill.

MATCHER DISCIPLINE, hard-coded: use substring or an explicit character class for every column-name sweep, never a word boundary. r'\bMEMBER[1-8]\b' matches 0 of 54 rows because MEMBER1DOB puts an alphanumeric straight after the digit. State the matcher beside every text-derived count.

NEVER infer an instance label from a column prefix. On BJAZ_BANDHAN_MEDI_CLAM, P_ and M_ mean PERMANENT and MAILING, not proposer/member. The settled map already carries the correct answer in target.instance ('permanent' / 'mailing') on 10 of 13 rows, so the build must READ it. Inferring proposer/member would overwrite a member's mailing address with their permanent one.

The map is NOT handoff-clear even though validate_mapping now PASSES with 0 blockers (was 171, all legacy): check_collapse still EXITS 1 on pre-existing findings. 11 single-active fan-ins remain untouched - the sharpest puts 7 columns on SAT_COMMON_CONTACT.'Email Address' from BJAZ_HM_HOSP_MASTER_EXTN1 (CEO, ADMIN, BILLING, TPA, MEDDIR, MEDSUPER, MKTHEAD) and 6 on 'Mobile Number' - plus 8 dangling redundant_of pointers. Read check_collapse's exit code UNPIPED: it shows 0 through a pipe and 1 unpiped.

COMPLETING THE FIELD CORRECTION: there are THREE child-key spellings and they are COMPLEMENTARY, not alternatives. child_key = leg NAME (435 populated: 199 target / 236 augmentation); child_key_value = rendered VALUE (524: 276/248); child_key_components = structured legs (160: 14/146). 139 containers populate all three and 48 populate child_key ALONE - a leg name with no value, which a two-field reader would drop. Stage 1 must read all three in BOTH containers. key_name (306, target only) is a HUB business-key name and never co-occurs with any child-key field. Three states must also be carried per row - ABSENT, PRESENT_NULL and the literal string 'None' are different, and on the 54 MEMBER rows key_name/instance are PRESENT_NULL while child_key_value/child_key_components are ABSENT entirely.
